adaptiveattacks.ability.dragon.dragon_ov: Grants the Ender Dragon a burst of speed and increased damage below 25% health.
adaptiveattacks.ability.dragon.homing_fi: Launches a fireball that tracks the nearest player.
adaptiveattacks.ability.dragon.vulnerabl: Marks the Ender Dragon as vulnerable below 25% health, amplifying incoming damage.
adaptiveattacks.ability.wither.freezing_: Passive companion to Nuclear Winter; applies Slowness to nearby players while active.
adaptiveattacks.ability.wither.nuclear_w: The Wither detonates a spreading field of wither skulls that lingers and chills the area.
adaptiveattacks.ability.wither.shatter_w: Passive companion to Nuclear Winter; sends a knockback shockwave through the area on detonation.
adaptiveattacks.ability.warden.echo_stri: Passive; deals bonus Sonic Boom damage to players tagged by Echolocation Shockwave.
adaptiveattacks.ability.warden.echolocat: Emits a shockwave that tags nearby players, priming them for Echo Strike follow-up hits.
adaptiveattacks.ability.warden.sculk_suf: Encases a player in sculk growth, applying Blindness and Darkness while the Warden kites.
adaptiveattacks.ability.warden.the_silen: A one-time effect that silences all nearby players, suppressing sound cues for the fight's duration.
adaptiveattacks.ability.generic.rush.gap: Teleports the boss directly behind the closest player when playing an aggressive archetype.
adaptiveattacks.ability.generic.rush.kin: Fires a harpoon-like projectile that pulls the hit player toward the boss.
adaptiveattacks.ability.generic.rush.sha: The boss briefly blinks out of sight before reappearing beside its target.
adaptiveattacks.ability.generic.kite.rea: Surrounds the boss with a ring of damage spikes for a short duration when a kiting archetype is active.
adaptiveattacks.ability.generic.kite.rep: Blasts all nearby players away from the boss to maintain kiting distance.
adaptiveattacks.ability.generic.kite.tox: Leaves a trail of Poison clouds as the boss retreats from melee range.
adaptiveattacks.ability.generic.hybrid.c: Randomly swaps positions with a nearby player, disorienting the party.
adaptiveattacks.ability.generic.hybrid.d: Raises a temporary barrier of solid blocks between the boss and its attackers.
adaptiveattacks.ability.generic.hybrid.m: Tethers two players together, forcing them to stay close or take increasing damage.
